_comment: Independent trap.c hero landmine setup: seed 7949 and the D:8 layout expose a natural mine at (35,12), one square east of the hero. The hero walks onto it, converts it to a pit, and reaches trapeffect_pit through dotrap(RECURSIVETRAP). The route differs from the monster steering witness while keeping the setup bounded and source-derived.
